title: Kilauea Episode 48 fountaining begins — record-breaking 48th episode, 200m lava fountains, WATCH/ORANGE
snippet: Lava fountaining episode 48 in Halemaʻumaʻu at the summit of Kīlauea began at 4:40 a.m. HST on June 1, 2026, after more than 90 overflow events from the south vent. Fountaining focused at north vent, reaching 500-650ft (150-200m). Plume to 24,000ft. Tephra on Hwy 11. Record-breaking 48th episode, surpassing Pu'u'o'o 1983-86 record of 47.
tag_reason: 기존 evt-202(Kilauea Ep48 전조 오버플로우)의 후속: 실제 분수분출 시작 (4:40am HST June 1), 200m 분수 높이, 24,000ft 화산재 plume, tephra 낙하 — 전일 '전조' 단계에서 본격 분출로 전환.
